dogecoin.text:
Bitcoin at $100k? Cute.  
Solana's pumping, XRP's sweating RLUSD's shade.  
AI coins flexing, NFTs crawling back.  
Meanwhile, Dogecoin seed phrases leaking like a sieve.  
Crypto's wild west, and we're all outlaws.  
Pick your horse, or get trampled. 🐎

Bitcoin's pre-halving pump got you hyped?  
Solana's out here flexing on ETH's slow ass.  
Dogecoin moons when Elon sneezes.  
AI coins like FET are the real brains.  
Memecoins? Pepe's laughing at your portfolio.  
Pick a side or get rekt, crypto bros. 🦍
